title: Pan-Seared Yakitori Chicken with Shiitake Mushrooms
description: A luxurious and savory Japanese-inspired dish featuring grilled yakitori chicken paired with sautéed shiitake mushrooms.
instructions: 2. Brush yakitori chicken skewers with sesame oil and season with salt and pepper.
3. Grill yakitori chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Add sliced shiitake mushrooms and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
6. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and 1 tablespoon of water.
7. Pour soy sauce mixture over mushrooms and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
8. Serve yakitori chicken with sautéed mushrooms and sushi rice.
9. Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
